text:
Maya: quick check — after upgrading to Poetry 1.5 our project now resolves httpx 0.24 and mypy is failing on the SDK's AsyncClient usage. CI started failing on typing errors. anyone seen this? cc @Kevin @Olivia

Kevin: what exact mypy error are you seeing? can you paste a minimal snippet?

Maya: here's the usage that trips it:```py
from redwood_sdk import AsyncClient

async with AsyncClient(api_key=...) as client:
    async for chunk in client.stream_chat(...):
        handle(chunk)
```
mypy: error: "AsyncClient" is not an async context manager (got type "AsyncClient")

Olivia: ugh yeah — httpx recently tightened types for AsyncClient/AsyncClient.__aenter__/__aexit__ across 0.23 -> 0.24. SDK currently exposes a thin wrapper that relies on httpx's typing. two options: pin httpx to <0.24 or update our wrapper types.

Leo: quick workaround is to cast in user code:```py
from typing import cast, AsyncContextManager
client = cast(AsyncContextManager, AsyncClient(...))
async with client: ...
```
it's gross but unblocks CI while we patch.

Maya: thanks. we run both local dev with pip + venv and CI with poetry install --no-root. seems to produce different locks. anyone have recommended flow for Docker-based CI?

Chris: we standardized on exporting requirements.txt from poetry for Docker to avoid resolver drift:```bash
poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes --output requirements.txt --dev
pip install -r requirements.txt
```
that keeps build deterministic in containers where pip is used.

Olivia: also consider adding a constraint in pyproject to avoid httpx 0.24 until we bump SDK typing:```toml
[tool.poetry.dependencies]
httpx = "^0.23.0"
```
or use the `dependency` section to pin exact.

Maya: there's also a retry/backoff conflict — some teams depend on urllib3/backoff and poetry picks a conflicting backoff wheel pulled by httpx extras. CI pip install fails with non-resolvable constraints on alpine musl image. any tips?

Kevin: for alpine, many wheels fail. either use slim-buster/stretch image or install musl build deps (gcc, musl-dev, libffi-dev) before pip. Alternatively force a pure-Python backoff version that matches other libs.

Leo: FYI I opened a tiny PR to the SDK to add explicit AsyncContextManager protocol to our client wrapper and a mypy config tweak: allow-untyped-context-manager = false -> true for tests. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/402 (draft).

Maya: awesome. timeline? if we have that merged we can unpin and avoid forcing httpx version for users.

Leo: should be reviewable today — needs a small typing stub and a changelog entry.

Chris: one more note — if anyone runs into streaming quirks where the first chunk is delayed unless you await client.connect() explicitly, that's due to an implicit retry/backoff policy in the transport. You can pass `transport=AsyncHTTPTransport(retries=0)` to reproduce.

Maya: thanks all. I'll: 1) pin httpx in the app to unblock CI, 2) export requirements for Docker builds, 3) test Leo's PR and remove pin afterwards. will post results here. :+1:

ci-bot: automated check — created issue #714 (py-sdk-async-typing) and queued a follow-up job to run full matrix on the PR.
